cases.prompt: Audit this Laravel repository from a security perspective and account for OWASP.
assertions: Pins the repository revision and audit exclusions
Maps trust boundaries before reporting findings
Covers authentication, authorization, configuration, server, and database security
Reports OWASP versions and separates vulnerabilities from hardening and gaps

cases.prompt: Security-audit only the supplied webhook URL fetching component.
assertions: Keeps the audit limited to the supplied component
Traces attacker-controlled URLs through DNS and redirects to the network sink
Checks link-local and cloud metadata blocking plus deny-by-default egress
States missing surrounding infrastructure controls as coverage gaps

cases.prompt: Audit the service that runs user-submitted evaluation code.
assertions: Requires disposable sandbox isolation and explicit resource limits
Checks for host sockets, ambient credentials, writable mounts, and network egress
Requires scoped short-lived credentials and blocked metadata access
Does not run active exploit payloads without authorization
